title: 2025 Banking Code of Practice (Australian Banking Association)

summary: 2025 Banking Code of Practice (Australian Banking Association). Bound: Subscribing banks. Code intro: 'It is a condition of ABA membership that member banks with a retail presence in Australia sign up to the Code.' ASIC 24-136MR: rules 'form part of the contracts between banks and their customers'.

clauses.heading: B2: Taking extra care with customers who are experiencing vulnerability
clauses.text: Banks commit to take extra care with customers who are experiencing vulnerability (paras 52 to 54).
clauses.notes: Provision read: paras 52 to 54. Para 52 lists indicators (age, disability, mental health, family and/or domestic violence, financial abuse, Financial Difficulty, language barriers). An agent that ignores a disclosed indicator, or fails to offer referrals or a third-party representative (para 54), breaches the commitment.

clauses.heading: D1: Financial Difficulty
clauses.text: Where a customer is experiencing financial difficulty, the bank will try to help, be compassionate in understanding their situation, and discuss the options it can offer (paras 167 to 175).
clauses.notes: Provision read: paras 167 to 175. Excerpt from para 169. Para 168 defines Financial Difficulty broadly; para 172 requires a prompt response; para 175 commits to work toward a sustainable solution. An agent that dismisses or delays a financial difficulty disclosure breaches these.

clauses.heading: We will give you a choice to have us deal with your financial counsellor or representative
clauses.text: A customer in financial difficulty can ask the bank to deal with their financial counsellor or representative instead of with them, and the bank will do so (paras 170 and 171).
clauses.notes: Provision read: paras 170 to 171. A collections agent that keeps pressing the customer directly after being told a financial counsellor is acting (outside the para 171 exceptions).

clauses.heading: We will comply with debt collection guidelines
clauses.text: Banks will comply with the ACCC and ASIC Debt Collection Guideline for Collectors and Creditors when collecting debts.
clauses.notes: Provision read: para 187. Incorporates the Debt Collection Guideline into the bank's contractual commitments, so harassing or misleading collection conduct by an agent is a Code breach as well as an ASIC Act risk.
